title: Pleasant brain states are more compressible

statements.text: More pleasant brain states should be more compressible, all else being equal: high-density EEG from pleasant states, with or without a TMS pulse, should compress better when the degree of consciousness is controlled.
statements.falsification_criteria: Pleasant states do not show higher compressibility of hd-EEG than unpleasant states at matched levels of consciousness.

sources.quote: More pleasurable brain states should be more compressible (all else being equal)
